items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 23 June 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the North Sea covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, becoming northerly overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair at first, then a risk of mist and fog patches developing for a time later tonight and at first tomorrow in central and western areas.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally poor in any mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4, veering east 3 or 4 overnight into Thursday, occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
